notProven: No completeness claim for all Navy creation and activation paths.
No conclusion about the eventual fate of a patrol from staging alone.
Sensor detection, combat physics, casualties and eventual victory are external outcomes.
Unmarked mixed legacy queues retain native scripted authority; their origin cannot be inferred.
covered: Ordinary weighted FactionShip, nav-GUI deferred caller and post-finale FactionBattle.
Native selection can construct/reuse reserve hulls or recruit active Navy actors.
Player-relative position, velocity and rotation writes.
Physical region/speed eligibility, busy candidate exclusion, unchanged fleet cap accounting.
Native Navy patrol admission, emergency scheduling and isolated legacy restoration.
General native one-shot callback and FIFO persistence, with explicit counterfactual control outcomes.
opaque: Complete combat trees, human agendas, new hull/crew construction and subsequent flight.
Native RNG/weighted eligibility and candidate choice are explicit external inputs.
Selection=existing scenarios use a full fleet and a single eligible native candidate; they do not claim other candidates are unavailable in all worlds.
